contexts.text: Camels carrying wax, resin, and stacte () = the interior goods of such. (Compare AC 4748.)

Wax, and stacte () = the truths of good of the interior Natural; for wax, here, aromatic wax, = the truth of good... By wax, here, is not meant common wax, but aromatic wax, such as storax. It is this kind of wax which is meant by the (Hebrew) word here used, which also means spice. From this it is evident why this aromatic wax = the truth of good; for all spices, because sweet scented = the truths which are from good. Explained. (See Stacte.)
Bees... build cells of wax... The wax serves the whole human race for lights. DLW 356. TCR 13:3.
They gather wax from flowers for a home.
Have stopped their ears as with wax, SE 3410:end. They are rather waxen lights, because there is in them more of sulphur than of tallow.
Of these evils... it is said that they are melted as wax before the fire ().
